Statement (registered sorry body): for T >= 1, if (1/T) sum_{t : Fin T} a_t <= eps then some a_t <= eps. True (an average is at least the minimum). Gives the 'some iterate is eps-stationary in expectation' conclusion.

Statement (registered sorry body): if pi is measurable and Q.map pi = P, then for F AE-strongly measurable w.r.t. P, F integrable under P implies F o pi integrable under Q, and int F o pi dQ = int F dP. True (Mathlib integral_map / integrable_map_measure). Pure change-of-variables helper.

Statement (registered sorry body): for valid parameters q, f satisfying FrobeniusSmooth L and bounded below, the oracle model (IID coordinates of P with marginal mu, IsStochasticGradient f g sigma), and ANY measure Q on any Xi with a measurable pi : Xi -> (N -> Omega) and Q.map pi = P, the setup's Guarantee holds for the iterates W_xi = trajectory(publicInput q, g, pi xi) under Q. This is exactly what Convergence needs: the template evaluates success under dirac x P with the oracle seed as second component (pi = Prod.snd). True: Q is a probability measure (its pushforward P is), measurability transfers by composition, integrals transfer by transfer_integral, the first display follows from the accepted frobenius_main (Fin vs range sums agree), the tuned clause from tuned_generic with K = r L (whose beta rule min(sqrt(r L Delta)/(sigma sqrt(r T)),1) equals the setup's min(sqrt(L Delta)/(sigma sqrt T),1) for r > 0) and E[f(W_0) - f(W_T)] <= Delta (W_0 = W0, f >= inf f by BddBelow), the complexity clause from complexity_generic (Delta > 0 forced by eta > 0) and exists_le_of_avg_le. So it transports the complete Theorem 4.1 guarantee (lines 258-266) to the template's probability model without adding assumptions.
